base: Use case: stylized-concept. One polished concept sheet for strategy game 阴山：公司战争. Style references only, do not edit them. Match reference ivory and warm gray angular industrial architecture, fine subdued gold seams, minimalist corporate uncanny atmosphere; crisp large material planes with softly painterly rendering. No anime, no cartoon, no generic military space marine, no medieval fantasy. Plain warm light-gray studio background. Show one LARGE complete three-quarter hero view plus two smaller consistent supplementary views (front/rear for humanoids, alternate angle/top or cutaway for structures/devices). Objects fully visible, clean generous layout, strong readable game silhouette, subtle material swatches. Reference employee is faction style guide, NOT a requirement to make devices humanoid.
first: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished game unit concept sheet for 阴山：公司战争, U01 攻坚者Ⅰ型. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match ivory/off-white and warm gray industrial geometry, restrained thin gold seams, softly lit architectural minimalism. Subject: mass-produced humanoid corporate employee resource, stamped light alloy skeleton, standardized office synthetic-fiber cladding resembling a plain bureaucratic suit integrated with angular machine panels, blank face with tiny standby indicator eyes, thin economical limbs, unsettling impersonal demeanor. NOT military space marine, not anime. Show one large full-body 3/4 view and smaller consistent rear and front views, separated clearly on warm light gray background, readable silhouette for top-down strategy game, subtle material swatches, professional 3D-modeling concept quality, restrained painterly edges and crisp hard-surface planes. No scenery, no cropped limbs, no gore. Only text: 'U01' and '攻坚者Ⅰ型'. Reference city is not an edit target.
